articles.summary: Industry Veteran Mike Wilson to Retire; Leo Oei to Assume Senior Commercial Role BlueLinx Holdings Inc. (NYSE: BXC), a leading U.S. wholesale distributor of building products, today announced that Mike Wilson will retire as the Companys Chief Commercial Officer, effective January 4, 2026, and serve as Senior Advisor to the CEO through August 1, 2026.
